# Abuzar Raziq

> Backend Engineer focused on Node.js, TypeScript, and clean, well-structured APIs.

## About

Abuzar Raziq is a backend engineer based in Islamabad, Pakistan. He builds and maintains
REST APIs and backend services with Node.js, TypeScript, Express, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL.
His work centers on authentication, JWT auth, hashing, validation, pagination, filtering,
and realtime features with WebSockets. He runs Arch Linux, uses Neovim, and cares about
security and data integrity in everything he ships.

## Experience

- Backend Developer Intern — DUMMY: Some Agency — Jun 2024 to Dec 2024
  (API design, validation, and database schema design; Express, MongoDB, Postman)
